Abstract.AbstractText: A method for the synthesis of diversely substituted 3-fluoropyridines from two ketone components is described. The reaction involves photoredox coupling of α,α-difluoro-β-iodoketones with silyl enol ethers catalyzed by fac-Ir(ppy)3 under blue LED irradiation with subsequent one-pot condensation with ammonium acetate. Based on cyclic voltammetry studies, it was determined that α,α-difluoro-β-iodoketones are reduced notably easier compared to 2,2,2-trifluoro-1-iodoethane, which may be ascribed to the influence of the carbonyl group.
